executive_summary: Today's intelligence picture is defined by two reinforcing dynamics: a sharpening of great power confrontation across multiple domains, and a simultaneous acceleration of defensive posturing by US allies acting with greater strategic independence. The direct US military strikes against Iranian naval assets at Bandar Abbas, corroborated by open-source imagery of battle-damaged US aircraft at RAF Mildenhall, confirm active kinetic engagement with Iran and suggest operations are broader or more intense than publicly acknowledged, while concurrent USAF drone deployments to the Middle East following MQ-9 losses indicate a theater adapting under attrition pressure. In the Euro-Atlantic space, Dutch seizure of 800 servers linked to Russian cyber operations runs parallel to European leaders accelerating strategic autonomy plans, suggesting European capitals are connecting the dots between Russian hybrid warfare and their dependence on US security guarantees that may no longer be reliable under current US policy. Meanwhile, the China ground-effect weapons prototype sighting, combined with the US-Japan missile exercise planning and South Korea's trans-Pacific submarine deployment, points to a coordinated Allied effort to harden Pacific deterrence as Beijing advances novel power projection capabilities. The industrial cybersecurity items, while tactical in isolation, carry strategic weight in this context, as adversaries with demonstrated cyber aggression and the capacity to strike critical infrastructure represent a compounding risk at a moment when Western military and industrial systems are already operating under elevated stress.

sections.title: Cyber
sections.intro: Major infrastructure seizures and retail breaches dominated cyber developments, with Dutch authorities dismantling Russian attack infrastructure while convenience store chains face significant data compromises.

items.headline: Dutch Police Seize 800 Servers Used in Russian Cyber Operations Against EU
items.summary: Netherlands authorities arrested two hosting company co-owners and seized their server infrastructure that was being used by Russia to conduct cyberattacks, influence operations, and disinformation campaigns targeting the European Union. The companies had taken control of technical infrastructure previously operated by Stark Industries Solutions, an internet service provider sanctioned by the EU in 2025. This represents a significant disruption of Russian cyber capabilities operating from European soil.

items.headline: 7-Eleven Confirms Data Breach Affecting 600,000 Salesforce Records
items.summary: The global convenience store chain acknowledged unauthorized access to systems containing franchisee documents, with threat group ShinyHunters claiming responsibility for stealing over 600,000 Salesforce records containing personal information. This breach highlights ongoing vulnerabilities in retail supply chain data management and the persistence of established threat actors targeting customer databases. Organizations should review their Salesforce security configurations and franchisee data protection protocols.

sections.title: Geopolitical
sections.intro: Memorial Day brings reflection on ongoing military commitments while Europe accelerates preparations for reduced American leadership.

items.headline: US Military Maintains Global Deployment Despite Memorial Day Remembrance
items.summary: American servicemembers remain deployed in combat zones worldwide, making Memorial Day observances particularly poignant for current operations. The ongoing deployments underscore that military sacrifice continues beyond historical conflicts, creating immediate obligations for policymakers and the public. This reality bridges the gap between honoring past losses and managing present risks to deployed forces.

items.headline: European Leaders Accelerate Strategic Autonomy Plans Amid Trump Policies
items.summary: European nations are intensifying efforts to reduce dependence on American leadership following what officials describe as problematic bargaining approaches from the Trump administration. The shift represents a fundamental recalibration of transatlantic relations rather than temporary policy adjustments. Watch for concrete steps in defense spending, technology partnerships, and diplomatic initiatives that bypass traditional US-led frameworks.

items.headline: Morocco's Colonial Legacy Remains Contested Century After Rif Rebellion
items.summary: The interpretation of Abd el-Karim's anti-colonial resistance continues to shape contemporary Moroccan politics and regional identity. Competing narratives about the Rif Rebellion reflect ongoing tensions between monarchist legitimacy and populist nationalism. This historical debate influences current policy toward regional autonomy and Morocco's relationship with former colonial powers.

sections.title: Military
sections.intro: Military developments today span active operations in the Middle East, strengthening Pacific alliances, and continued concerns over China's nuclear capabilities.

items.headline: U.S. Forces Conduct Defensive Strikes Against Iranian Naval Assets in Bandar Abbas
items.summary: Central Command launched strikes targeting Iranian boats and launch sites in response to threats from Iranian forces. The action represents a significant escalation in Gulf tensions and demonstrates continued U.S. willingness to respond militarily to Iranian provocations. Watch for Iranian retaliation and potential broader regional impacts.

items.headline: Japan and U.S. Plan Major Pacific Exercises with Advanced Missile Systems
items.summary: Two major exercises scheduled for late June will include deployment of the containerized Typhon missile system, which will remain stored in Japan afterward rather than being removed as in previous deployments. This marks a significant shift in U.S. regional military posture and demonstrates deepening Japan-U.S. defense integration amid China tensions.

items.headline: South Korea Achieves Historic Trans-Pacific Submarine Deployment to Canada
items.summary: The ROKS Dosan Ahn Changho completed South Korea's first trans-Pacific submarine voyage, arriving at Canadian Forces Base Esquimalt. This milestone demonstrates South Korea's expanding blue-water naval capabilities and strengthening ties with Pacific allies beyond the immediate region. The deployment signals Seoul's growing confidence in projecting naval power globally.

sections.title: Intel / OSINT
sections.intro: Open source intelligence reveals escalating operational tempo in Middle East conflicts, Chinese military modernization advances, and US surveillance capability adjustments.

items.headline: Battle-damaged US KC-135 tanker photographed at RAF Mildenhall shows Iran attack effects
items.summary: Visual evidence captured at the UK base reveals shrapnel damage to another US Air Force KC-135 tanker, providing concrete assessment of Iranian weapons effectiveness during recent Middle East operations. The public visibility of such damage offers rare insight into operational impacts typically classified, suggesting either deliberate transparency or intelligence collection opportunities for adversaries.

items.headline: China's ground-effect aircraft prototype spotted with weapons mounting points
items.summary: New imagery of China's experimental 'Bohai Sea Monster' ground-effect vehicle shows apparent weapons hardpoints, indicating development beyond transport toward potential combat roles. This wing-in-ground-effect platform could provide unique low-altitude capabilities for littoral operations, particularly relevant to Taiwan Strait scenarios where conventional aircraft face increasing air defense threats.

items.headline: USAF deploys ULTRA surveillance drones to Middle East following MQ-9 losses
items.summary: The Air Force is sending its new high-altitude ULTRA glider drones to the Middle East theater, responding to persistent surveillance gaps created by Iranian-inflicted MQ-9 Reaper losses. These turbocharged platforms offer extended loiter capabilities that could prove harder for adversaries to target, representing tactical adaptation to evolving threat environments.

sections.title: ICS / SCADA / OT
sections.intro: Industrial cybersecurity advances today focus on improving defensive capabilities, with new AI-powered penetration testing tools and updated NIST guidance for ransomware recovery in manufacturing environments.

items.headline: AI-Powered Penetration Testing Tools for Industrial Systems Transition from Research to Practical Implementation
items.summary: Researcher Isiah Jones has consolidated multiple AI-driven security testing projects into a comprehensive methodology specifically designed for industrial control systems. This development represents a significant advancement in automated vulnerability assessment capabilities for OT environments. The toolkit could enable more systematic and efficient security testing of critical infrastructure systems.

items.headline: NIST Issues Draft Guidance on Ransomware Response and Recovery for Manufacturing Networks
items.summary: The National Institute of Standards and Technology released the initial public draft of Special Publication 1800-41, focusing specifically on ransomware incident response and operational recovery in manufacturing environments. This guidance addresses the unique challenges of restoring production systems while maintaining safety and operational integrity. The publication fills a critical gap in sector-specific ransomware recovery procedures for industrial organizations.
